```lean
theorem lg_target {y z : ℝ} (f : ℝ → ENNReal) (hzy : z ≤ y) : ∫⁻ (x : ℝ) in Set.Iic y, f x = (∫⁻ (x : ℝ) in Set.Iio z, f x) + ∫⁻ (x : ℝ) in Set.Icc z y, f x := by
  have h_union : Set.Iio z ∪ Set.Icc z y = Set.Iic y := by
    rw [Set.Iic, Set.union_Iio_Icc]
    exact le_refl _
  rw [h_union]
  exact measure_theory.integral_add (measure_theory.measure_space.ENNReal_measure _) (measure_theory.measure_mono.mono (le_refl _) hzy)
```
